Scripts check ranks d=2,4,6,8 and exhaustive side-coloring counts d=2,4; finite tests are corroborative.

value.rationale: For the canonical optimal four-color construction on even cubes, the theorem counts every parity-split optimum and identifies a full self-dual affine code, not just a single instance or scalar minimum. The double-exponential multiplicity and algebraic structure inform enumeration of optimal placements and distinguish construction entropy from the already-known chromatic minimum. This is a natural side-restricted infinite-family classification, not an arbitrary finite slice.
